post_process_inference_result: post process an AlphaFold inference result to extract CIF data, confidence scores, and ranking metrics
write_output: write an AlphaFold inference result to a directory as CIF and JSON confidence files with optional compression
write_embeddings: write a dictionary of numpy embedding arrays to a compressed NPZ file in the output directory
ProcessedInferenceResult: review the ProcessedInferenceResult dataclass that stores CIF bytes, mean confidence, ranking score, and model ID
summarize_post_processing: summarize the AlphaFold post processing module that converts inference results into CIF and JSON output files
